name: Builder's Talent
description:
When this Class enters, create a 0/4 white Wall creature token with defender.

{W}: Level 2.

When this Class becomes level 2, put a +1/+1 counter on target creature.

{4}{W}: Level 3.

When this Class becomes level 3, return target permanent card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
assumptions: Decoded the non-registry thing key w_0_4_wall_defender (node D) as a 0/4 white Wall creature token with defender by reading its own segments the same way registry entries like hero-token/horror-1 encode color/stats/subtype/keyword.

Treated node F (trigger-type "enter") as parallel to node I (trigger-type "classlevelgained") — both a "this Class reaches a new level" trigger — since both sit downstream of a becomes node with cond:class_level=N in the same shape.
Rendered the two becomes nodes carrying cost:{...} and cond:class_level=N (E, H) as the standard Class activated-ability line "{cost}: Level N."
couldNotDerive: Whether the level-2 and level-3 triggered abilities are worded differently in print, given the data distinguishes their trigger-type values without explaining what textual difference that signals.
Any restriction narrower than bare type on G's target creature or J's target permanent card.
notes: Second attempt (2026-09-03) found node F's thing had silently fallen back to 'self' (ValidCard$/ValidCards$ field-name split bug) and lost the nonCreature+nonLand qualifiers entirely (qualifierFlags had no .nonCreature support). Both fixed; re-verified directly against the regenerated packet on 2026-09-04 rather than a 3rd live exam: node D correctly resolves to the wall-1 token (0/4 white Wall, defender), F now carries 'cond:nonland cond:noncreature' exactly matching "noncreature, nonland permanents," G's PutCounter target/owner are correct, and J (Level 3's graveyard-return) correctly carries the same nonland+noncreature qualifiers with owner:me via ValidTgts$...YouOwn. All three Class levels now fully match forge-model/data/builder-s-talent.txt's real oracle text. In blb-success.json.
